name: FIMS & Nursing Building
summary: Two stone and glass wings frame the east courtyard, with the north wing projecting over a recessed glazed level and the south wing having narrow window stacks above a stone base with long slit windows.

evidence.note: The two bars run east from a tall west link. The north bar has a long rooftop equipment screen. Low paving and planting fill the east court.
Regional 2 m surface relative to local ground. Median 19.22 m, 90th percentile 25.3 m, maximum 27.77 m.
Rough grey stone at grade, horizontal strip window, smooth belt and narrow silver window frames above.
Long northern glazing sits behind closely spaced vertical blades.
The glass end projects over the lower level.
Two-storey courtyard glazing, terrace and a projecting glazed corner.
Steel columns carry the projecting north wing above glazing and an east terrace.
Design account distinguishes the FIMS north wing and Nursing south wing.
Main wall colour sampled with PIL from KartaView 136656559. 800 × 600 pixel reference, patch centred at (718, 410), 7 × 7 pixels.
The 1 m surface traces a broad west roof near 25 m. Multiple cells across the southern Nursing bar measure 14.8–15.4 m. The lowest storey is partly buried on the south approach.
The narrower lower glazing band lacks the projecting silver blades visible above. Two recessed cylindrical columns carry the east end. The balustrade returns onto the courtyard elevation.
North roof returns extend out to x 389 at z 555 and x 384 at z 565. Moving the whole facade several metres west would remove occupied roof. The Nursing roof cuts back near x 379 and z 593.
